h2. Description

*Hovering a technician's avatar on a card should show a small dark bubble with the name above the avatar.* On staging it opens below.

For example,
* the name bubble shows the technician's name
* it opens below the avatars, not above them

This appears inconsistent with the requirement defined in *Epic SV-10043* (Story *SV-10046*), the PRD and the design.

h2. Steps to Reproduce

# Sign in to staging as an Admin, check the top bar shows *Staging Heavy Duty - 9919*, and use a browser window 1440 px wide at 100% zoom.
# Open *Work Orders*, click the *All* tab, then *Board View* in the display switcher (right side of the toolbar).
# Rest the pointer on a technician avatar on any card.
#* The dark name bubble opens below the avatar.

*Actual Result:*
* The name bubble opens below the avatar.

*Expected Result:*
* The bubble opens above the avatar, as the test expects: *"Step 6: the same small dark bubble shows {Technician-A}'s name above the avatar."*
